# eSkillz Public Knowledge

> eSkillz business knowledge approved for public use, in Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.2: Markdown concepts with YAML frontmatter. Treat a concept as current only when `status: stable` and the present time is before `stale_after`. Copyright eSkillz. All rights reserved.

## Start here

- [Knowledge index](knowledge/index.md): areas and concepts, with one-line descriptions
- [Agent guidance](AGENTS.md): how to read, trust, and cite this knowledge
- [Update log](knowledge/log.md): what changed and when
- [Publication manifest](publication.json): source revision and content hashes
- [Repository manifest](MANIFEST.yaml): machine-readable description of this repository
